coder_notes: High-grade glioma with BRAF aberration; glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title or inclusion criteria -> high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclusion at S5). Mirrors manual example: HCQ added to dabrafenib + trametinib (or trametinib) in patients with prior RAF/MEK inhibitor therapy -> HCQ experimental_monotherapy, dabrafenib/trametinib soc_backbone (given in every relevant arm; HGG Phase I patients may be RAF/MEK-naive). BRAF V600 is required for strata 1, 3, 4 and BRAF fusion/duplication for strata 2, 5 (enrichment). NF1 is a germline syndrome defining a stratum (recorded as other, enrichment). LC3II and p62 autophagy markers are measured in PBMCs (not tumour) and the plasma/CSF resistance biomarker is unspecified; not recorded. Paediatric and young adult population (CHILD, ADULT).
